usedFor: Paystack takes payments, and Google Drive shares a file when “New Order” runs “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Paystack, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A paid order can deliver a download link to its file at the access level you choose.

watchOut: “New Order” only looks at recent orders, so the link goes after a scheduled check.
